criterion: Playwright (both iPhone profiles): a logged-in person sees Hem, Organisation and Konto in the tab bar, each opens its screen, and the open one has aria-current="page".
Playwright: a logged-out visit to the Organisation tab lands on /app/login.
Playwright: "Logga ut" on Konto ends the session (a later GET /api/v1/me is 401) and lands on /app/login.
Playwright: creating an organisation on the Organisation tab lists it, and choosing it shows its name on Hem.
Playwright: no request goes to fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com, and both font families load from the app's origin.
Playwright with colorScheme dark and light: the ground, panel and text colours computed on Hem match DESIGN.md's table.
Playwright at 390px wide with the root font size doubled: no horizontal scroll on any tab, and the tab-bar labels keep their size.
impeccable audit on the changed screens has no P0 or P1 finding.
